question: Which massive sports talent hunt, launched by Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar in May 2025, involves the participation of students from secondary and higher secondary schools?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mashal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **May 2025**, the Chief Minister of **Bihar**, **Nitish Kumar**, launched a massive sports talent search initiative named **Mashal**.
 
• The primary objective of the **Mashal** program is to identify and nurture athletic talent at the **grassroots level**, specifically targeting students enrolled in **secondary and higher secondary schools** across the state.
 
• The scheme involves a structured selection process where students from **Class 9 to Class 12** participate in various sporting disciplines to showcase their potential.
 
• The **Bihar State Sports Authority (BSSA)** is the nodal agency responsible for the execution of this talent hunt, ensuring that identified students receive professional coaching and access to **residential sports academies**.
